editionLabel: Original standalone Black Plague English base game
firstPlayerRule: Decide who starts and give that player the first-player token. The token holder takes the first turn; the next player is on their left.
clarifications: The Black Plague rulebook gives no required method for deciding who receives the token.
At the end of each game round, pass the first-player token to the player on the left.
